prompt: An α,β-unsaturated ketone (enone) has its C=O band around 1685 cm⁻¹. Why is it lower than a regular ketone (~1715 cm⁻¹)?

options.label: Conjugation delocalizes the C=O π bond, lowering its force constant.
The sp² CH is more electron-donating than sp³.
The reduced mass of C=O is larger.

explanation: Conjugation lowers the effective C=O bond order via resonance delocalization, which drops the stretching frequency by ~30 cm⁻¹.
